named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item reporting that Argentina's Undersecretariat of Information Technologies adopted Disposición 2/23 on 2 June 2023, incorporating UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of AI into national practice. It highlights ethical principles to prevent bias, inequality and rights erosion. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Argentina's Disposición 2/23 (2 June 2023) is based on UNESCO's AI ethics Recommendation
The measure aims to set clear rules so technology benefits all sectors and strengthens innovation
UNESCO urges ethical principles to counter manipulation, inequality, bias and rights erosion
The Recommendation was approved by 193 member states in 2021
annotation.title_clean: Argentina implementa normativa en base a la Recomendación sobre la Ética de la Inteligencia Artificial de la UNESCO
annotation.title_en: Argentina implements regulation based on UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
